spec_references: ## Expressions: supported expression list includes 'Type test expression' and 'Type cast expression', but does not include typeof/type-of expressions.
reason: The tuple conversions use explicitly supported cloneWithType, but the executed runtimeTypeName helper requires the unlisted typeof expression. Several @output assertions depend on (typeof value).toString().substring(9) producing exact runtime type names (Teacher, Employee, map<anydata>). This essential reflection behavior is not covered by the supported expression list, so the whole case is feature scope.
unsupported_constructs: typeof value expression and runtime typedesc-name reflection used by runtimeTypeName
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: supported tuple cloneWithType conversions and ordinary value/type checks are combined with unsupported typeof-based runtime type-name assertions.
Exact type-name outputs additionally depend on typedesc string formatting and the hard-coded substring offset 9; supported toString/substring signatures alone do not establish that representation.
